liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Easy Wind** (2 reviews): Easy Wind is singled out for its gnarly biker sound on the soundboard; Called the best Easy Wind ever: psychedelic blues that returns at the end to a slow, gritty groove [11][14]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Bob's guitar solo jam in Hard To Handle is a surprising highlight [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-04-04.sbd.sirmick.76807.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says each instrument sounds amazing, and suggests using EQ during playback; Sound problems remain throughout, including a stuttering effect, yet it far surpasses the audience recording [1][12]
- **gd1971-04-04.sbd.miller.110325.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 4.12/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Charlie Miller master: Jerry's voice smooth, his guitar warm, Bob's guitar ringing with a jazz-like tone [16]
- **gd71-04-04.aud.cotsman.10358.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording terrible, suitable only for completists; The audience recording has a poor reputation, but the master reel sounds much better [6][10]
- **gd1971-04-04.sbd.GEMS.35252.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 147 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard sound fabulous, with a gnarly, biker-like tone [11]

## Around the show

- This was the first of three Manhattan Center nights [8]
- Reviewer says New York crowds loved Pigpen, and this show features him prominently [13]
- April 5 was the best of the run, though this night had several magnificent moments [8]
- Several tracks on the album "Grateful Dead" came from the second and third nights, not this one [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-04-04.sbd.sirmick.76807.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by this is a partial clean up of shnid 35252 by SirMick; source: MSR > C >DAT3 > Delta DiO 2496 > SoundForge 7.0 > cdwav > flac > wav > flac [1]. Also: Partial clean-up of shnid 35252: a small gap was removed and Drums retracked separately; The uploader chose not to patch problem tracks with the circulating audience tape because of its inferior quality [1]
- **gd1971-04-04.sbd.miller.110325.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> CD [2]. Also: Pitch correction was applied to this soundboard with help from Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd71-04-04.aud.cotsman.10358.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Walter Schnell and JCotsman; source: Audience [4]
- **gd1971-04-04.sbd.GEMS.35252.flac16**: transferred by GEMS; source: MSR>C>DAT3x>Delta DiO 2496>SoundForge 7.0>cdwav>Flac [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Leeway's Home Grown Music Network: [Grateful Dead - Shakedown New York (2CD)](https://homegrownmusic.net/store/cd/grateful-dead-shakedown-new-york-2cd) [19]
